items.title: Did Diop deny a clear goalscoring opportunity?
items.description: Ashley Young and Steve Cooper discuss whether or not Issa Diop denied James McAtee a clear goalscoring opportunity.

items.title: 'We had to scrap' - O'Neil praises Ipswich resilience after Forest draw
items.description: Ipswich manager Gary O'Neil praises his side's ability to "dig in and fight" as his side come from behind to earn a 1-1 draw against Nottingham Forest at Portman Road in the Premier League.

items.title: 'It doesn't make sense' - Glasner confused after Diop avoids red card
items.description: Nottingham Forest manager Oliver Glasner admits he was left confused by the decision to not send off Issa Diop after a VAR check during his side's 1-1 draw at Ipswich Town, but praised his side's performance and urged them to 'stay patient' as Forest's winless run stretched to four matches.

items.title: Forest out of relegation zone after cagey draw at Ipswich
items.description: FREE TO WATCH: Highlights from the Premier League match between Ipswich Town and Nottingham Forest.

items.title: Five-goal thrashing sends Boro top of Championship
items.description: Highlights of Bolton against Middlesbrough in the Sky Bet Championship.

items.title: Wasteful Forest held by Ipswich amid VAR controversy
items.description: Nottingham Forest's woes in front of goal continued as they were held to a 1-1 draw at Ipswich despite dominating the game.

items.title: Ipswich latest: Survival won't be easy despite strong start, says O'Neil
Lankshear at the double as Middlesbrough thump Bolton to go top
items.description: Middlesbrough moved to the Sky Bet Championship summit in emphatic fashion by thumping Bolton 5-1 at the Toughsheet Community Stadium.

items.title: Forest left frustrated as winless run goes on after draw at Ipswich
items.description: Nottingham Forest ended a run of three successive league defeats but endured another night of missed chances as they drew 1-1 at Ipswich Town in the Premier League, but the result does move the away side out of the relegation zone on goal difference.

items.title: Borussia M'gladbach finally get first win after five-goal thriller
items.description: Bundesliga's bottom side Borussia Monchengladbach come from behind to beat Stuttgart 3-2, as the away side secure their first league win of the season, at the seventh attempt.

items.title: Villa could reconsider Garnacho deal - Saturday's gossip
items.description: Aston Villa have doubts on making Alejandro Garnacho deal a permanent move, Brighton to stand firm on Diego Gomez amid interest, Manchester United managerial candidates concern over players, plus more.

items.title: When Carra met Chelsea boss Alonso
items.description: Sky Sports' Jamie Carragher sat down for a wide-ranging interview with Chelsea manager Xabi Alonso in which the pair discussed his appointment at Stamford Bridge and his aims for the season, as well as looking back at their time playing together at Liverpool.
